statements.text: But I want to hear from you. What are your top questions about our new legislation, or how Congress is approaching AI?

We shouldn’t just wait for superintelligence to show up. We need to do something now.

This is not a radical notion. It’s one of the most obvious parts of our bill, and Congress should pass it.

Our bill bans recursive self-improvement.

If an AI system shows warning signs of automating AI development, it's cut off from the internet. If it can't be made safe within 30 days, it's shut down for good.

It's like jet fuel for AI. And top scientists are sounding the alarm.

Asked about recursive self-improvement, Yoshua Bengio, a "godfather of AI," told CNN last week: "We shouldn't actually even engage in this. It should be illegal."

AI companies already use AI to help build AI. But humans are still steering.

Voters just sent a clear message: a few AI billionaires shouldn’t get to decide whether you keep your job, or whether we survive as a species.

We all should have a say, not just the billionaires. https://t.co/PHtsT8wJqE
